item.name: Common Egg
item.petPool: Hatches one of two Common pets: Capybara or Golden Retriever, both giving a small income boost.
item.cardSummary: The cheapest starter egg, bought from the Egg Merchant for 25 million Cash. It only hatches the two Common pets, so it is mainly an early-game step.

item.name: Uncommon Egg
item.petPool: Hatches Uncommon pets such as the Llama and Elephant.
item.cardSummary: A low-tier cash egg at the Egg Merchant that steps you up from Common pets to Uncommon ones like the Llama and Elephant. Its exact Cash price is not shown here yet.

item.name: Rare Egg
item.petPool: Six pets across Uncommon, Rare and Epic: Llama, Elephant, Gorilla, Crocodile, Lion and Polar Bear. Lion and Polar Bear are the rarest pulls.
item.cardSummary: A mid-game cash egg from the Egg Merchant costing 25 billion Cash. Its six-pet pool tops out at the Epic Lion and Polar Bear.

item.name: Epic Egg
item.petPool: Eight pets from Uncommon up to Secret: Elephant (~33%), Llama, Crocodile (~33%), Gorilla (~20%), Lion (~20%), Polar Bear (~9%), Mammoth (~1.6%) and the Secret Hydra (~0.3%).
item.cardSummary: A late-game cash egg that adds the Legendary Mammoth and the Secret Hydra on top of the Rare Egg pool. Stock rotates on a timer, so it is not always for sale at the Egg Merchant.

item.name: Legendary Egg
item.petPool: Contains Epic, Legendary, Secret and Prismatic pets, including the Secret Rhino and the Prismatic Red Panda.
item.cardSummary: The top cash egg, costing 100 trillion. It is the highest-rarity egg you can buy with farmed Cash and can hatch up to Prismatic pets like the Red Panda.

item.name: Dinosaur Egg
item.petPool: Five dinosaurs: Gallimimus (~52%), Triceratops (~30%), Spinosaurus (~15%), Velociraptor (~2.5%) and the Divine T-Rex (~0.5%). The only egg that can hatch Divine pets.
item.cardSummary: A limited Robux egg from the Premium Shop and the only source of Divine-rarity pets. Bulk buys are sold at higher Robux tiers, and it can be gifted to other players.

item.name: Carnival Egg
item.petPool: Five carnival pets: Bumper Snail, Jackpot Slime, Prizewheel Peacock, Token Toad and the Exotic Claw Machine Kraken.
item.cardSummary: A limited carnival-themed Robux egg from the Premium Shop. Its five-pet pool runs up to the Exotic Claw Machine Kraken, and bulk buys are offered at higher Robux tiers.
